```mjs title=main.mjs
import { rspackRequire, moduleFactories } from "./runtime.mjs";
import * as __rspack_external_fs from "fs";
moduleFactories.add({
"fs?94de"
/*!*********************!*\
  !*** external "fs" ***!
  \*********************/
(module) {

module.exports = __rspack_external_fs;


},
"./cjs-consumer.cjs"
/*!**************************!*\
  !*** ./cjs-consumer.cjs ***!
  \**************************/
(__unused_rspack_module, exports) {
// CJS module - will NOT be scope-hoisted, causing its fs dep
// to go through init fragment path instead of raw_import_stmts
const fs = rspackRequire(/*! fs */ "fs?94de")
exports.g = fs.readFileSync


},
});
// fs?fa25

// ./esm-consumer.js
// ESM module importing fs namespace - will be scope-hoisted (Concatenated)



// ./cjs-bridge.js
// ESM bridge that re-exports from a CJS module
// This module is ESM but its dependency is CJS, so the CJS module
// and its dependencies (including fs) won't be scope-hoisted


// ./index.js
const cjs_consumer = rspackRequire("./cjs-consumer.cjs");



it('should not have duplicate import identifiers from mixed scope-hoisting', () => {
	expect(__rspack_external_fs).toBeDefined()
	expect(cjs_consumer.g).toBeDefined()
})

export {};

```

```mjs title=runtime.mjs

var modules = {};
// The module cache
var moduleCache = {};
// The require function
function rspackRequire(moduleId) {
// Check if module is in cache
var cachedModule = moduleCache[moduleId];
if (cachedModule !== undefined) {
return cachedModule.exports;
}
// Create a new module (and put it into the cache)
var module = (moduleCache[moduleId] = {
exports: {}
});
// Execute the module function
modules[moduleId](module, module.exports, rspackRequire);

// Return the exports of the module
return module.exports;
}
export { rspackRequire };
// expose the modules object (modules)
var moduleFactories = modules;
export { moduleFactories };

// rspack/runtime/esm_register_module
moduleFactories.add = function registerModules(modules) { Object.assign(moduleFactories, modules) }
;


```
